observations: The source app-server started on an isolated Unix socket and exited cleanly.
The source app-server proxy connected to the socket.
The proxy forwards raw WebSocket bytes and does not decode JSONL.
The current desktop app-server processes use stdio:// rather than a shared Unix listener.
The documented control-socket path was present but had no owning process during inspection.
verdict: Do not implement a JSONL proxy adapter. Use a real WebSocket client against a Dream-House-owned Unix listener or add a separately reviewed event mirror.
